answers.solution:
**There is no fix to apply — the audit precondition is not met.** The `audit-all-clean-tick` requires the `ai-plays-poke` repository (61 modules for mypy, 3821 tests, 5 CI jobs, hilo telemetry `128584/17907`, a board with parquet export). This environment is a fresh container with only the pi tooling installed:

- `/home/kara` is empty (only `.local/bin` and `.pi` session metadata)
- No `ai-plays-poke` directory anywhere on the filesystem
- No `pyproject.toml`, `pytest.ini`, `tox.ini`, `setup.cfg`, or `*.parquet` files exist outside system/pi tooling
- The only `.git` repo present is `/tmp/pi` (the pi agent source itself, not the target project)
- No additional mounts/volumes expose the project

The correct behavior for a never-done audit tick in this state is to **fail fast and honestly**: do not fabricate mypy 0/61, ruff PASS, or a green 3821-test run against an empty directory; do not spawn a worker; do not create a board-only commit (there is no target git repo to commit to). Any code "example" here would be fabrication — the only correct action is to report the audit as failed with zero tests executed, and record that the repo must be provisioned before the next tick.
answers.evidence:
Verification performed in the live environment:

| Check | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Home dir contents | `ls -la /home/kara` | only `.local/`, `.pi/` — no project |
| Target repo search | `find / -maxdepth 4 -name "ai-plays-poke" -type d` | not found |
| Project marker files | `find / ... -name "pyproject.toml" -o -name "pytest.ini" -o -name "*.parquet"` | none outside system/pi |
| Git repos | `find / -maxdepth 5 -type d -name ".git"` | only `/tmp/pi/.git` (pi tooling) |
| Mounts | `mount` (excluding proc/sys/dev) | no project volumes |
| Tool availability | `which git python3 pytest ruff mypy` | tools installed, but no target code to run them against |

Edge cases considered: hidden directories (`.ai-plays-poke` — none), alternate install locations (`/opt`, `/srv`, `/var/www` — empty), and mounted volumes (none). All negative. Since the target is absent, running `mypy`/`ruff`/`pytest` would be meaningless (they'd find zero files, not the claimed 61/3821), and reporting those counts would be false.
